title: For the customer with the highest total consumption across all months, comp
question: For the customer with the highest total consumption across all months, compute their average price per item (total price divided by total amount), their currency, and the percentage of their monthly consumption records that exceed 1000 units.

prediction.sql:
WITH TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT c."XCL_001" AS CustomerID
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c."XCL_001" = ym."XCL_019"
    GROUP BY c."XCL_001"
    ORDER BY SUM(ym."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(t."XCL_018") * 1.0 / SUM(t."XCL_017")
     FROM transactions_1k AS t
     WHERE t."XCL_013" = tc.CustomerID) AS AvgPricePerItem,
    (SELECT c."XCL_003" FROM customers AS c WHERE c."XCL_001" = tc.CustomerID) AS Currency,
    (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ym."XCL_021" > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
     FROM yearmonth AS ym
     WHERE ym."XCL_019" = tc.CustomerID) AS PercentageHighConsumption
FROM TopCustomer AS tc

WITH TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT c."XCL_001" AS CustomerID
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c."XCL_001" = ym."XCL_019"
    GROUP BY c."XCL_001"
    ORDER BY SUM(ym."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(t."XCL_018") * 1.0 / SUM(t."XCL_017")
     FROM transactions_1k AS t
     WHERE t."XCL_013" = tc.CustomerID) AS AvgPricePerItem,
    (SELECT c."XCL_003" FROM customers AS c WHERE c."XCL_001" = tc.CustomerID) AS Currency,
    (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ym."XCL_021" > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
     FROM yearmonth AS ym
     WHERE ym."XCL_019" = tc.CustomerID) AS PercentageHighConsumption
FROM TopCustomer AS tc

        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        ym.XCL_020 AS month,
        SUM(t.XCL_016) AS total_consumption,
        SUM(t.XCL_017) AS total_amount,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_price,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t.XCL_016 > 1000 THEN 1 END) AS count_over_1000,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON t.XCL_011 = ym.XCL_020
    GROUP BY t.XCL_013, ym.XCL_020
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(total_consumption) AS total_consumption_all,
        SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount_all,
        SUM(total_price) AS total_price_all,
        SUM(count_over_1000) AS total_count_over_1000,
        SUM(total_records) AS total_records_all
    FROM customer_monthly
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        total_consumption_all,
        total_amount_all,
        total_price_all,
        total_count_over_1000,
        total_records_all
    FROM customer_totals
    ORDER BY total_consumption_all DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    tc.total_price_all / tc.total_amount_all AS avg_price_per_item,
    c.XCL_003 AS currency,
    (tc.total_count_over_1000 * 100.0) / tc.total_records_all AS pct_over_1000
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON tc.customer_id = c.XCL_001

WITH TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT c."XCL_001" AS CustomerID
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c."XCL_001" = ym."XCL_019"
    GROUP BY c."XCL_001"
    ORDER BY SUM(ym."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(t."XCL_018") * 1.0 / SUM(t."XCL_017")
     FROM transactions_1k AS t
     WHERE t."XCL_013" = tc.CustomerID) AS AvgPricePerItem,
    (SELECT c."XCL_003" FROM customers AS c WHERE c."XCL_001" = tc.CustomerID) AS Currency,
    (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ym."XCL_021" > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
     FROM yearmonth AS ym
     WHERE ym."XCL_019" = tc.CustomerID) AS PercentageHighConsumption
FROM TopCustomer AS tc
